question: How does clear awareness arise in the examination of a gem?
premises: In the examination of a gem, one awakens one's own awareness.
This awakening occurs through assemblages of other cognitions.
The resulting awareness stands forth as clear in nature.
inference: Clear awareness of an object is brought about through the support of other cognitions.
plain_english: Just as in examining a gem one awakens one's own clear awareness through assemblages of other cognitions, so that awareness stands forth distinctly.
